title: Scheduled restricted estimator query count
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a Boolean function on the sign cube, let $J$ be a subset of the coordinates, and let $S$ be a subset of $J$. For rational parameters $\varepsilon,\delta$ with $0<\varepsilon,\delta\le 1/2$, every outcome in the support of the scheduled restricted Fourier weight estimator's cost distribution has query count $2m$, where $m=\lceil2b(\delta)/\varepsilon^2\rceil$ and $b(\delta)=\lceil\log_2\lceil2/\delta\rceil\rceil$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the sign cube
$J$ is a subset of the coordinates
the outcome belongs to the support of the estimator's cost distribution
